meta.description: Shopify fires an order-created webhook per order, which can burst past your ERP's per-second rate limit during a flash sale. Instead of calling the ERP directly, this workflow hands each order to Jitterflow, targeted per shop domain — Jitterflow jitters and paces delivery to stay under the ERP's rate limit, and retries/DLQs anything the ERP rejects, without your workflow needing its own retry logic.
setup: Replace YOUR_JITTERFLOW_ENDPOINT_KEY with an endpoint whose destination URL points at your ERP's order-import API.
Set the endpoint's cadence/jitter window in the Jitterflow dashboard to match your ERP's documented rate limit.
Wire the Shopify Order Webhook node's URL into your Shopify app's webhook subscriptions (orders/create).
